calendar attachment

  • CURIE: gmeow:calendarAttachment
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/calendarAttachment
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/email

Links a message to the specific attachment that carries iCalendar data (mediaType text/calendar). A specialization of gmeow:hasAttachment that keeps the attachment first-class and separate from the parsed event representation.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:EmailMessage -> gmeow:Attachment Sub-property of: gmeow:hasAttachment

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:calendarAttachment from gmeow:EmailMessage to gmeow:Attachment when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:hasAttachment, gmeow:EmailMessage, gmeow:Attachment
